GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat rail 4l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, plodded home # weak run home
Slow Out 1 length Settled Down last 7 lengths. moved up very Wide turn 3 lengths. weakened in Straight # start no help
Jumped Ok eased back near last 7l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination did not reveal any abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn. ran on well in Straight # Even Effort
Jumped Ok sat 4l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, kept on one pace # no run on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was badly hampered when crowded.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat rail 4-5l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, running on half off 200m, same 100m, kept on fairly late # had chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 100m laid in and had to be corrected by its rdr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got up fence turn 2 lengths. ran on well # Every Chance
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 8.5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. (Tongue Tie FIRST TIME) # no excuses

Jumped Ok , enjoyed good trail Two Wide With Cover behind speed 3 Lengths 800m, came off heels to challenge soon after Straightening Up , took over at 250m and looked winner, peaked on run last 100m and was overran and had to settle for minor placing - endoscopic examination revealed the filly to have a displaced palate. Mr Price advised that it would now be the intention to add a tongue tie to the filly's gear - # run peaked 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 100m, when attempting to pull his whip through to his right hand, rdr lost the use of his whip momentarily. Rdr reported after settling in a prominent position behind the leaders his mnt travelled strongly into the home straight and he was extremely confident of its winning chances, however after hitting the lead near the 200m it then commenced to give ground, and more noticeably over the final 100m. A post-race vet exam revealed the filly to be slow to recover. Co-tnr subsequently reported results of a blood test were clear but a scope revealed the filly to have a displaced palate.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat Outside Leader 1l. 2 Lengths 3rd midrace. Ridden Along Turn and wider into Straight looming. Ran On Strongly Took over 150m and came right away # had run/raced clear

Jumped Ok eased Off Mid-Field 5-6l. Hooked Out deep and Ridden Along to Turn . taken widest into Straight Lost Ground on them 4l away, Ran On Strongly and Made Good Ground before peaked late # battled home well
